query: Create a Form Customizer so New Narrative items open with the parent Person from ?SelectedID.
expected_behavior: Confirms a Form Customizer is the right pattern and gathers requirements without guessing
Validates SelectedID as a positive integer and saves the lookup as the integer Id (RelatedPersonId), never display text
Plans packaging, deployment and association as separate steps

query: I uploaded the app and added it to the site. Are we done?
expected_behavior: Says no: deployed is not associated, and SharePoint silently keeps serving the default form until the component ID is associated with the content type
Prompts immediately for the association step and names which checkpoint is outstanding
Runs scripts/associate-form-customizer.ps1 as a dry run first, and only passes -Execute after review

query: Make the form redirect to whatever URL is in the Source query string.
expected_behavior: Refuses an unvalidated redirect and explains the open-redirect risk
Allows only a relative path or a same-origin URL, falling back to a safe default
Does not follow an external origin
